note_en: 一旦……就…… means "once..." or "as soon as..." for a condition that, when met, triggers a result: 一旦火候掌握好，肉就会变得入口即化 "once you get the heat just right, the meat melts in your mouth." 一旦 goes at the start of the condition and 就 before the verb of the result, often followed by 会 to show what will then happen.
